title: Getting Started – Install & Use
content:
1. Install the Plugin

  • Copy to Plugins/
  • Enable in Plugins window
  • Restart Editor

2. Open the Tool

  • Open Skeletal Mesh
  • Click "Make Vertex Animation (VAT)"

3. Generate VAT

  • Select Animations
  • Click Generate

title: Important Notes
content:
Important Notes
This plugin is Editor-only and has no runtime cost.
Requires Unreal Engine 5.7 or later.
Skeletal Meshes must have valid Animation Sequences.
VAT generation may take time for high-frame animations.
AnimToTexture plugin must be enabled.
Supported languages: English / Chinese.
